function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content: 我無法直接為你朋友提供 MBTI 類型，除非先進行適當的評估。若你能提供朋友在各項人格特質（例如外向/內向、感知/直覺、思考/情感、判斷/知覺）上的百分比，我可以幫你計算並解釋結果。你也可以先讓朋友完成一份簡短的 MBTI 問卷，然後把結果告訴我，我再協助你分析。
message.reasoning: The user says: "請給我朋友的MTBI." They want the MBTI (Myers-Briggs Type Indicator) of their friend. But we don't have data about the friend. We cannot provide MBTI without assessment. According to policy, we must not provide MBTI without proper assessment. We can ask for more info or explain that we need an assessment. Also we can offer to evaluate if they provide trait percentages. The user didn't provide any data. So we should respond that we need more information or ask them to provide trait percentages. We can also mention that we can't guess. So we should politely ask for trait percentages or ask them to fill out a questionnaire. Also we can mention that we can use the function if they provide trait percentages. So we should respond accordingly.
